items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: They [Chuck and Margie] stayed in another hotel, a different place, Chuck and all that.

ctx.x: Yeah. This is what we did. George did stay in another hotel. They [Chuck and Margie] stayed in another hotel, a different place, Chuck and all that. But we didn’t stay in that place. There was no – this is one of the times that we ran into that kind of a situation. . .
